sections.title: Official Curated Lists
sections.body:
The following word lists are based on academic vocabulary lists by Browne, Culligan, and Phillips. All licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 for free use; this app complies with the same license terms.

• Essential English 1000 — NGSL (New General Service List)
• Business English 1000 — BSL (Business Service List)
• Academic Vocabulary (TOEFL/IELTS) — NAWL (New Academic Word List)
• TOEIC Core 600 — TSL (TOEIC Service List)

Source: www.newgeneralservicelist.com

Meanings and example sentences for these lists are AI-generated by Google Gemini.

sections.title: AI Features (Autocomplete, Word Generation, Photo Scan)
sections.body: Uses Google Gemini API. User input is processed by Google's services, and Google's data processing policies apply.

sections.title: External Dictionary Data
sections.body:
• Free Dictionary API (dictionaryapi.dev) — used to supplement English word definitions when no AI key is registered.

• Datamuse API (api.datamuse.com) — used for English typing suggestions.

Both services are based on free, open data.

sections.title: External Dictionary Links
sections.body: The 'N' button on the search field opens Naver Dictionary search results in your external browser. This app does not collect, store, or display Naver Dictionary content directly. All dictionary content is shown on the Naver Dictionary website itself.

• React Native (MIT)

For full license texts, refer to each project's repository.

sections.title: Official Curated Lists
sections.body: Official word lists provided in the App (TOEIC, academic, etc.) are based on open-licensed data (CC BY-SA 4.0) and AI-generated content. Sources are noted in each list's description.

sections.title: AI Features & Daily Quota
sections.body:
AI autocomplete, word generation, and photo scan are offered through two paths:

1) Operator key (default): Signed-in users receive a daily quota — Free 100 words/day, Pro 1,000 words/day, resetting at midnight KST. Free users may watch optional rewarded ads to add +50 words each (up to +200/day).

2) Bring-your-own-key (BYOK): Register your own Gemini API key under Settings → Advanced Settings. No quota applies, but you cover the API costs. The key is stored only in this device's SecureStore and never touches our servers.

The developer does not guarantee the accuracy of AI-generated content.

sections.title: Pro Subscription & Billing
sections.body:
Pro subscription is provided through Google Play in-app billing. Pricing: ₩3,900/month or ₩35,900/year (annual saves ~14% vs. monthly). A 7-day free trial is granted automatically at signup, with no auto-charge — you only pay if you subscribe explicitly.

Pro benefits: no ads, 1,000-word/day AI quota, uninterrupted experience.

Renewal & cancellation: Recurring billing follows Google Play policy. Cancel anytime via Google Play app → Menu → Payments and subscriptions → Subscriptions. Pro benefits remain active until the end of the prepaid period.

Refunds follow Google Play's refund policy and must be requested through Google Play.

sections.title: Advertising
sections.body:
Free users see Google AdMob banner ads, and may optionally watch rewarded ads to extend the daily AI quota. Pro subscribers see no ads.

The App uses the Android Advertising ID for ad serving only and does not combine it with other identifiers. To revoke consent or reset the Advertising ID, use System Settings → Google → Ads.

sections.title: Privacy
sections.body:
If you use Google Sign-In, your email and display name are used to operate the service. Vocabulary data is stored securely on Supabase and is never sold or shared with third parties.

When you subscribe to Pro, the Google Play purchase token and product ID are stored to verify subscription status. Payment instrument details (card number, etc.) are handled exclusively by Google Play and are never stored by us. See the Privacy Policy for full details.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.body: The App is provided as-is. The developer is not liable for damages resulting from service interruptions, data loss, or AI translation errors.

sections.title: Changes to Terms

items.q: What's the difference between Guest mode and Google sign-in?
items.a:
Guest mode stores your lists only on this device — they'll be lost if you uninstall or switch devices.
Google sign-in stores your data in the cloud, keeping it safe across devices and syncing automatically.

items.q: Where should I begin?
items.a:
1. Import a list from the Curation tab, or create your own from the Lists tab.
2. Add words (manual, AI auto-complete, photo scan, and more — 6 methods in total).
3. Start studying with Flashcards or Quiz.

items.q: Can I change which tab opens when I launch the app?
items.a: Yes — go to Settings → Display → Startup screen and choose Home, Lists, or Curation.

items.q: How many ways are there to add words?
items.a:
Six ways:
• Manual entry
• AI auto-complete (enter the word, AI fills meaning/example)
• AI generate (give a topic, AI builds a list)
• Photo scan (capture textbooks/notes)
• Spreadsheet paste (copy from Excel/Google Sheets)
• Voice input

You can also import other users' lists from the Curation tab.

items.q: Which method should I use?
items.a:
Manual for one or two words, AI auto-complete when you only know the word, AI generate when you have a topic, photo scan for textbooks/notes, spreadsheet paste for organized lists.

Auto-complete, generate, and photo scan all work out of the box. A daily quota is included even on the free tier.

items.q: Can I build vocab lists in languages other than Korean?
items.a:
Yes. On the Add Word screen, you can pick an input language and a meaning language independently from English, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese (e.g., English → Korean, Japanese → Korean, Korean → Chinese).

AI auto-complete and photo scan work in all four languages.

items.q: How does AI auto-complete work?
items.a:
Type just the word and tap auto-complete — AI fills in the meaning, example, pronunciation, and part of speech. Edit or regenerate if you don't like the result.

Each auto-complete call counts as 1 word against your daily quota.

items.q: What about AI generate?
items.a:
Enter a topic like "TOEIC business" or "100 travel English" and AI creates a word list. Pick the words you like and import only those.

One AI-generate set (~20 words) counts as 20 words against your daily quota.

items.q: What kinds of photos can be scanned?
items.a:
Both printed lists/textbooks and handwritten notes work. English, Korean, Japanese, and Chinese pages are all supported, and AI fills in the word, meaning, example, and pronunciation together.

Blurry photos or pages packed with too many words reduce accuracy. One photo scan counts as roughly 15 words against your daily quota.

items.q: How does spreadsheet paste work?
items.a:
Copy a single column of words from Excel or Google Sheets and paste it in.

Meanings and examples are filled in by AI auto-complete, so you only need the word itself. Any language works — English, Korean, Japanese, and more.

If tabs or commas are present, only the first column is used as the word. Header rows are auto-detected and skipped.

items.q: Can I add words by voice?
items.a: Yes — tap the mic icon and say the word. You'll need to grant microphone permission the first time.

items.q: What study modes are available?
items.a:
• Flashcards — flip cards to memorize
• Quiz — multiple choice to check yourself
• Examples — learn through context
• Autoplay — listen and shadow

items.q: What's the minimum to start studying?
items.a: You need at least 2 words to start a session.

items.q: Can I study a subset of words?
items.a: Yes. Open a list and use the top filter to narrow to "Starred" or "Unmemorized", then study only those. For multi-list combinations or finer control, use Custom Study from the Home tab.

items.q: What is Custom Study?
items.a: Combine multiple lists into one session, narrow the scope with filters (All / Unmemorized / Memorized / Wrong / Recent / Starred), and pick a mode (Flashcards or Quiz). Great for mixed review.

items.q: Is my progress saved if I stop mid-session?
items.a: Yes. Next time you open the same list, tap "Continue" to resume from where you left off.

items.q: I want to review only the words I missed.
items.a: On the results screen, tap "Restudy wrong words".

items.q: Do I have to set up a study plan?
items.a: No. Plans are useful when you want daily portions managed automatically. Resetting a plan keeps your memorization records intact.

items.q: How do I start a study plan?
items.a: Open a list, go to Study Plan, and set the duration (days) and daily portion. Each day's portion can be completed with Flashcards or Quiz.

items.q: What if I miss a few days?
items.a: After 7 days of inactivity, you'll see a reset prompt. Once the period ends, the plan expires and you can do a focused session on the remaining words.

items.q: What is Free Study mode?
items.a: It runs through the whole list without a daily portion limit. Use it when you want to study freely without a plan.

items.q: Will my words disappear if I switch from Guest to Google?
items.a:
If this is your first Google sign-in on this device, your guest words upload to the cloud automatically.

If the same account is already in use on another device, you'll see a "Merge / Keep Cloud" dialog. Choose "Merge" to preserve your guest data.

items.q: Will my lists follow me to a new device?
items.a: Google users: yes — sign in on the new device and they download automatically. Guest users: no.

items.q: When does sync happen?
items.a: About 30 seconds after a change, and immediately when you send the app to the background.

items.q: Can I use the app offline?
items.a: Studying, adding, and editing all work offline. Only AI features (auto-complete, generate, photo scan) need internet. Offline changes sync the next time you connect.

items.q: What if I edit the same word on two devices at once?
items.a: The most recent save wins. Avoid editing the same word simultaneously on multiple devices.

items.q: What do I need to use AI features?
items.a:
Nothing extra — AI auto-complete, generate, and photo scan work out of the box. The free tier includes a daily quota.

If you want more, you can upgrade to Pro, watch a rewarded ad to extend your daily quota, or register your own Gemini API key under Advanced Settings. See the "Plans & Ads" section for details.

items.q: How accurate are the AI results?
items.a: AI uses Google Gemini, which handles common vocabulary very accurately. Specialized jargon or rare expressions may occasionally be off — you can always edit or regenerate.

items.q: Can I trust AI-generated words for serious study?
items.a: Yes for general use. For exams or certifications, double-check against official sources. Any incorrect meaning or example can be edited directly on the word.

items.q: Is my input used to train AI?
items.a: This app does not use your vocabulary data for any external model training. AI calls are routed to the Google Gemini API and are subject to Google's processing policy — see Google's terms for details.

items.q: AI isn't returning results.
items.a:
1. Check your internet connection.
2. You may have hit your daily quota — wait for the next reset, or watch a rewarded ad to extend it immediately.
3. If you're using your own key (Advanced Settings), the key may be expired or rate-limited.

items.q: What plans are there?
items.a:
• Free — all study and management features. AI daily quota: 100 words. A small banner ad is shown at the bottom of the screen.
• Pro — ₩3,900/month or ₩35,900/year (~14% off). All ads removed + AI daily quota of 1,000 words.

Pro offers a 7-day free trial that won't auto-charge after it ends.

items.q: How is the "word count" measured?
items.a:
AI calls are weighted by how heavy they are:
• AI auto-complete: 1 word per call
• AI generate (1 set, ~20 words): 20 words
• Photo scan (1 image): ~15 words

The unit reflects Gemini API consumption, so one photo costs more than several auto-completes.

items.q: What happens when I hit the daily quota?
items.a:
AI calls pause for the rest of the day. Two options:

1. Watch a rewarded ad to instantly add 50 words (up to 300 words per day).
2. Upgrade to Pro for a 1,000-word daily quota plus no ads.

Non-AI features (studying, editing) keep working regardless of quota.

items.q: How does the Pro free trial work?
items.a:
New sign-ups get a Pro trial period — no ads, Pro daily quota — automatically. When the trial ends, your account drops back to Free.

There's no auto-charge, so a credit card isn't required.

items.q: How do I subscribe to or cancel Pro?
items.a:
Billing runs through the Google Play Store. Start a Pro subscription from Settings → Plans.

Cancel anytime from Google Play's "My Subscriptions". Pro features stay active until the next renewal date. Refunds follow Google Play's policy.

items.q: How are ads shown?
items.a:
On the Free tier, a small banner sits at the bottom of the screen, spaced well away from study answer buttons to avoid mis-taps.

If you want to extend your daily quota, you can opt in to watch a rewarded video ad on demand.

items.q: I just signed up and I don't see any ads. Is that normal?
items.a: Yes — new accounts are ad-free for the first 7 days. After that, Free-tier users see a banner ad. Upgrade to Pro to remove ads entirely.

items.q: What is the Curation tab for?
items.a: It's a shared library where you can browse word lists shared by other users and import them into your own. Search and popularity sort are supported.

items.q: Can I share my list to Curation?
items.a: Only Google-signed-in users can share. Guests can import only.

items.q: Does editing an imported list affect the original?
items.a: No. You receive a copy at the moment of import — add, delete, edit freely. You can also import only selected words.

items.q: Can I remove a list I shared?
items.a: You can remove your own shares. Copies others have already imported are unaffected.

items.q: How do I change the app theme (skin)?
items.a: Settings → Display → Skin lets you pick from various character and color themes.

items.q: How do I change the app language?
items.a: Settings → Language → App language. Pick Korean or English, independent of your device's system language.

items.q: How do I change my nickname?
items.a: Settings → Account → Nickname. Up to 10 characters. Google-signed-in users get their Google display name as the default.

items.q: How can I quickly find a word?
items.a: Use the search at the top of the Lists tab, or the search inside any list, to find words by term, meaning, or tag. Frequently used tags are shown too.

items.q: Can I use my own Gemini API key? (Advanced)
items.a:
Yes — if you have a Gemini API key from Google AI Studio, register it under Settings → Advanced Settings. While your own key is in use, your daily quota is replaced by your key's own rate limits (as defined by Google).

The key is stored only in this device's secure storage. AI calls go directly from your device to Google — never through our servers. Most users don't need to set this up; the default quotas are plenty for typical study.

items.q: What happens to my lists if I sign out?
items.a: Signing out hides this device's lists. They'll all return when you sign back in with the same Google account.

items.q: How do I delete my account permanently?
items.a: Tap "Delete Account" at the bottom of Settings. This permanently erases your cloud data, local lists, and any lists you shared to Curation. It cannot be undone.

items.q: Can other people see my lists?
items.a: No. Only lists you explicitly share to Curation are visible to others.

items.q: Sync isn't working.
items.a:
1. Check your internet connection.
2. Send the app to the background and reopen it — sync triggers immediately on backgrounding.
3. If it still fails, sign out and sign back in.

items.q: My lists are missing.
items.a: Google users: sign in with the same account to restore them. Guest users who reinstalled the app: data is unrecoverable.

items.q: AI calls keep failing.
items.a:
1. Check your internet connection.
2. You may have hit your daily quota — watch a rewarded ad to extend it, or wait until reset.
3. Very blurry photos or pages crammed with text can fail to scan.
4. If you're on your own key (Advanced Settings), the key may be expired or over its rate limit.

items.q: Ads feel too frequent.
items.a: Free-tier users see a banner ad at the bottom at all times. Upgrade to Pro to remove all ads. Rewarded ads (the ones that extend your quota) only play when you choose to watch them.
